findings.statement: Line-specific paired-control scaling transfers induced native AF488 quantiles to a held technical block

reliability.rationale: Paired-control multiplicative mapping3272.21 native-unit MAE improves shift9471.53 and flexible8023.27 on one held technical block. Claim-specific scope: Line-specific paired-control scaling transfers induced native AF488 quantiles to a held technical block

mechanism.rationale: WT/mutant contrast is already published. Dimensionless distribution scaling is compatible with heterogeneous induction but does not identify recruitment, saturation or transporter chemistry.

novelty.rationale: Primary-source analyses and established equation families are disclosed. This review does not establish exhaustive literature novelty or a new universal law.

significance.rationale: Useful as a transparent bounded research/evaluation case. One plate, three technical blocks; nine quantiles per well are dependent. Missing manual gates and Alexa488 methods versus Alexa647 caption conflict bound dye-specific biological interpretation.

reproducibility.rationale: Exact task, equation/state, group evidence, native semantics and provenance inspected; separate computational review is responsible for complete replay.

impact.rationale: No independent deployment, intervention, cost saving or clinical/industrial acceptance outcome was measured.

reliability.rationale: All saved predictions and primary metrics independently reproduce from source-verified inputs, including unfavorable alternatives. One plate and absent author gates prevent biological or instrument transfer; AF488 versus captionAlexa647 discrepancy remains disclosed.
